channel.title: Input Channel
channel.description: For multi-channel microphones, select a single channel or average all channels

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep Mic Open Between Transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone stream open for 30 seconds after recording stops, reducing latency for back-to-back transcriptions. May degrade Bluetooth audio quality while active.

vadBackend.title: Voice Activity Backend
vadBackend.description: Choose the detector used to filter silence. Earshot is experimental; switch back to Silero if speech is clipped or noise is retained.

verificationMode.label: Verification Mode
verificationMode.description: Enable two-pass transcription. After the first transcription, a second model verifies and corrects uncertain segments for improved accuracy.

adaptiveThresholds.label: Adaptive Parakeet Thresholds
adaptiveThresholds.description: Automatically adjust Parakeet's internal thresholds based on audio characteristics for optimal transcription quality.

hybridMode.label: Hybrid Mode
hybridMode.labelTooltip: Automatically switch between two models based on recording length. Useful for users who alternate between quick voice commands and longer dictations.
hybridMode.description: Uses a fast model for short recordings and a more accurate model for longer ones. Assign models as SHORT or LONG in the Models tab.
hybridMode.descriptionDetail: Short recordings use a fast model that resists hallucinations. Long recordings use an accurate model optimized for sustained speech. Set the threshold below.
hybridMode.currentAssignment: Currently assigned: {{shortModel}} for short, {{longModel}} for long
hybridMode.noAssignment: No models assigned yet. Go to the Models tab to assign SHORT and LONG models.
hybridMode.thresholdDescription: Audio shorter than this uses the short audio model; longer audio uses the long audio model.
hybridMode.thresholdTooltip: Example: Set to 3s to use the SHORT model for quick commands under 3 seconds, and the LONG model for longer dictations.
hybridMode.assignHint: Assign models as SHORT or LONG in the Models section above. Each role uses a different model based on recording length.
hybridMode.shortAudioModelDescription: Model used for recordings under the threshold. Recommended: CTC models (Parakeet) or non-autoregressive models (SenseVoice) which don't hallucinate on short audio.
hybridMode.longAudioModelDescription: Model used for recordings at or above the threshold. Whisper models work well for longer audio.
hybridMode.shortBadgeTooltip: Best for short recordings: fast response, no hallucinations. Ideal for voice commands and quick phrases.
hybridMode.longBadgeTooltip: Best for longer recordings: higher accuracy for sustained speech. Ideal for dictation and meetings.

modelSpeedHint.fast: Fast model — ideal for SHORT role
modelSpeedHint.medium: Balanced speed — can work for either role
modelSpeedHint.slow: Accurate but slow — ideal for LONG role

whisper.title: Hardware Acceleration
whisper.description: Choose the hardware used for transcription. Auto uses the GPU when available and falls back to the CPU.

gpuDevice.title: GPU Device
gpuDevice.description: Select which GPU to use for Whisper inference. Auto picks the dedicated GPU.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start Handy when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the Handy icon in the system tray.

overlay.title: Overlay Position
overlay.description: Display visual feedback overlay during recording and transcription. On Linux 'None' is recommended.

overlayScale.label: Overlay Size
overlayScale.description: Scale the overlay pill and live captions. Large mode makes text easier to read.

overlayScreenTarget.title: Overlay Screen
overlayScreenTarget.description: Choose which screen the visualizer appears on. 'Side Screen' shows it on the screen your mouse is NOT on (requires multiple monitors).

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard Handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after text insertion. Cmd+Enter applies on macOS, while Windows/Linux use Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.
translateToEnglish.descriptionUnsupported: Translation is not supported by the {{model}} model.

convertUsToBritish.label: Convert to British English
convertUsToBritish.description: Convert US English spelling to British English (e.g., color → colour, analyze → analyse, center → centre).

convertNumberWordsToDigits.label: Convert number words to digits
convertNumberWordsToDigits.description: Convert spoken number sequences like "zero zero four" into digits "004". Applies to English transcriptions; lone number words are left as words.

modelUnload.title: Unload Model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time

customWords.title: Custom Words
customWords.description: Help supported models recognize names and specialized terms. Fuzzy correction is currently limited to words using A–Z and numbers.

customFillerWords.title: Custom Filler Words
customFillerWords.description: Add filler words to remove from transcriptions (like 'um', 'uh', 'like'). These words will be automatically filtered out from your transcribed text.
customFillerWords.duplicate: "{{word}}" already exists in your filler words list

fillerWordRemoval.title: Remove Filler Words
fillerWordRemoval.description: Removes common hesitation words from transcriptions. Turn off to keep them.

chineseScript.title: Chinese Script
chineseScript.description: Writes Mandarin and Cantonese transcriptions in Simplified or Traditional characters. Other languages are left unchanged.

vadSensitivity.title: Voice Detection Sensitivity
vadSensitivity.description: Controls when the app starts and stops recording based on voice activity. Higher sensitivity catches speech earlier but may pick up background noise.
vadSensitivity.veryQuickTooltip: Maximum sensitivity. Starts recording at the slightest sound. Best for quiet environments but may pick up background noise.
vadSensitivity.quickTooltip: High sensitivity. Good for normal environments where you want to capture everything, including soft speech.
vadSensitivity.balancedTooltip: Recommended for most users. Good balance between catching speech and ignoring background noise.
vadSensitivity.relaxedTooltip: Lower sensitivity. Requires clearer speech to trigger. Good for noisy environments to avoid false starts.
vadSensitivity.veryRelaxedTooltip: Minimum sensitivity. Only triggers on clear, loud speech. Best for very noisy environments or if you speak deliberately.

longFormChunking.title: Long Audio Chunking
longFormChunking.description: Splits long recordings at pauses before transcribing, which typically improves transcription performance.

liveCaptions.label: Live Captions
liveCaptions.description: Show live captions below the volume bars during recording. Uses additional CPU.
liveCaptions.modelDescription: Choose a dedicated model for live captions, or use the main transcription model.

noiseSuppression.label: Noise Suppression
noiseSuppression.description: Remove background noise before voice detection for improved accuracy in noisy environments. Increases CPU usage slightly.
noiseSuppression.levelDescription: Higher levels remove more noise but may slightly affect speech quality.
noiseSuppression.lowTooltip: Subtle noise reduction. Minimal impact on speech quality. Good for mild background noise.
noiseSuppression.mediumTooltip: Balanced noise reduction. Recommended for most noisy environments like cafes or offices.
noiseSuppression.highTooltip: Aggressive noise reduction. Best for very noisy environments but may introduce slight artifacts in speech.

provider.description: Select an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible provider.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

advancedCustomWords.title: Advanced Custom Words
advancedCustomWords.description: Add custom words with pronunciation variants. When the transcription matches a pronunciation, it will be replaced with the canonical word.
advancedCustomWords.toggleDescription: Switch to advanced mode with pronunciation variants. Only one mode (simple or advanced) is active at a time. Your words are preserved when switching between modes.
advancedCustomWords.pronunciationHint: Add ways the word might be transcribed. Each pronunciation will be used as a fuzzy match target.
advancedCustomWords.recordTooltip: Record yourself saying the word to automatically detect how the model transcribes it

wordReplacements.hint: Enter the text that appears incorrectly and what it should be corrected to

wordCorrectionMode.label: Word Correction Mode
wordCorrectionMode.description: Choose how custom words are matched: Prefer Custom Words (fuzzy bias), Match Pronunciations (sound-alike variants), or Exact Replacements (direct substitution)

historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

vadSensitivity.description: Controls when the app starts and stops recording based on voice activity. Higher sensitivity catches speech earlier but may pick up background noise.

vadSensitivity.quickTooltip: High sensitivity. Good for normal environments where you want to capture everything, including soft speech.
vadSensitivity.balancedTooltip: Recommended for most users. Good balance between catching speech and ignoring background noise.

noiseSuppression.label: Noise Suppression
noiseSuppression.description: Remove background noise before voice detection for improved accuracy in noisy environments. Increases CPU usage slightly.
noiseSuppression.levelDescription: Higher levels remove more noise but may slightly affect speech quality.
noiseSuppression.lowTooltip: Subtle noise reduction. Minimal impact on speech quality. Good for mild background noise.

postProcessingToggle.description: Enable AI-powered text refinement after transcription

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay
pasteDelay.description: Delay before sending paste keystroke (in milliseconds). Increase if wrong text is being pasted.

holdThreshold.title: Hold Threshold
holdThreshold.description: Auto mode only: how long (in milliseconds) the shortcut must be held before it counts as a hold instead of a tap. Lower if short holds keep leaving recording on; raise if deliberate taps get treated as holds.

recordingBuffer.title: Post-recording buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Maximum extra time (ms) to keep recording after you release the shortcut. The buffer stops early when the microphone detects silence, so it rarely waits the full duration. 0 = no extra buffer.

preRecordingBuffer.title: Pre-recording buffer
preRecordingBuffer.description: Capture audio from before you press the shortcut. Stores the last N ms of audio continuously while the microphone is kept warm, then prepends it to the recording so words you start before pressing the shortcut are not lost. Recommended: 1000-3000ms.

usbWatchdog.label: USB Power Watchdog
usbWatchdog.description: Automatically power-cycle the USB port when the microphone can't be opened. Requires uhubctl.
usbWatchdog.cycleOnWakeDescription: Automatically power-cycle the USB device when the computer wakes from sleep. Useful for devices that get stuck after sleep.

cycleOnWake.label: Cycle on Wake
cycleOnWake.description: Automatically power-cycle the USB port when the computer wakes up from sleep.

repetitionSuppression.title: Repetition Suppression
repetitionSuppression.description: Remove repeated consecutive words from transcriptions. Protected words (pronouns, articles, intensifiers) are never removed as they're often legitimate speech.
repetitionSuppression.protectedNotice: Protected words: I, you, the, a, very, so, and, or, but, to, for, with, is, was, etc. These are never deduplicated even if repeated.

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where Handy stores its data

whisper.details: Handy uses Whisper.cpp for fast, local speech-to-text processing. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.
